stories.title: Stripe Payment & Subscription System
stories.description: Implement comprehensive Stripe payment infrastructure supporting individual self-service subscriptions via Customer Portal and enterprise invoice-based billing. Integrate subscription validation into all auth flows (signup, login, onboarding, offboarding) with real-time sync to Supabase users and organizations. Handle payment failures, subscription lifecycle, seat-based pricing, and prorated upgrades/downgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Stripe SDK configured with server/client separation (src/lib/stripe/)
Database schema: subscriptions, subscription_items, invoices, payment_methods tables with RLS
Organizations table extended with stripe_customer_id, subscription_status, billing_tier
Users table extended with subscription_role (owner, admin, member) for seat management
Pricing page with 3 tiers: Starter (free trial), Professional ($99/mo), Enterprise (custom)
Stripe Checkout integration for new subscriptions with success/cancel redirects
Stripe Customer Portal integration for individual tier self-service (update payment, cancel, view invoices)
Enterprise tier invoice generation with NET 30 payment terms via Stripe Invoicing API
Signup flow: Create Stripe customer on org creation, redirect to plan selection
Onboarding flow: Block dashboard access until subscription active or trial valid
Login flow: Check subscription status, show grace period banner for past_due, block access for canceled/unpaid
Offboarding flow: Cancel subscription with immediate or end-of-period options, handle prorations
Webhook handler (api/webhooks/stripe) for subscription lifecycle events with signature verification
Handle events: checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.*, invoice.*, payment_intent.*
Billing settings page showing current plan, usage, next billing date, payment method
Subscription upgrade/downgrade with prorated billing calculations
Seat-based pricing for Professional tier with add/remove member billing
Failed payment retry logic with dunning email sequence via Resend integration
Subscription status real-time sync: Stripe webhook → Supabase → UI refresh
Usage metering preparation for future per-survey or per-review pricing models
Billing history with downloadable PDF invoices
Tax calculation integration (Stripe Tax or manual tax_rates)
gates: Stripe test mode checkout completes successfully
Webhook signature verification works with test events
Subscription status syncs within 5 seconds of Stripe event
Customer Portal redirect works for individual tier
Invoice generation works for enterprise tier
Auth flows block/allow based on subscription status

recommended_for.stripe_integration: stripe plugin (Create products, prices, test customers)

database_tables: subscriptions (id, org_id, stripe_subscription_id, stripe_customer_id, status, plan_tier, billing_cycle, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, trial_end)
invoices (id, org_id, stripe_invoice_id, amount_due, amount_paid, status, due_date, pdf_url)
payment_methods (id, org_id, stripe_payment_method_id, type, card_brand, card_last4, is_default)

auth_flow_integration.signup: Create Stripe customer → Store stripe_customer_id → Redirect to pricing → Checkout → Webhook confirms → Allow dashboard
auth_flow_integration.login: Fetch subscription status → Check active/trialing/past_due → Show appropriate UI/banners → Block if canceled
auth_flow_integration.onboarding: Middleware checks subscription_status → Redirect to billing if none → Complete onboarding after active
auth_flow_integration.offboarding: User clicks cancel → Confirm dialog → Call Stripe cancel → Webhook updates status → Show confirmation

file_structure: src/middleware.ts - Add subscription check to protected routes

phases.name: Foundation (MVP)
phases.description: Core infrastructure, authentication, and basic survey/review functionality

plugins.notes: Establish patterns that later phases will follow. Prioritize solid foundations.

phases.name: Enhanced Features
phases.description: Manager dashboards, Google integration, approval workflows, and analytics

recommended_for.S015: feature-dev:code-explorer (Understand existing auth before Google integration)

plugins.notes: Reuse Phase 1 patterns. Dashboard stories need polished UI via /frontend-design.

recommended_for.S019: feature-dev:code-architect (Sentiment analysis sets AI patterns for S020-S022)

plugins.notes: AI code complexity requires aggressive simplification. Review all AI integrations for security and rate limiting.

phases.name: Mobile & Integrations
phases.description: Mobile app, public API, integrations, and widgets

plugins.notes: Mobile UI must feel native. Widgets must be lightweight. API design should prioritize extensibility.

phases.name: Marketing & Growth
phases.description: Public marketing website, blog, animations, and public profiles

plugins.notes: Marketing pages define brand identity. Prioritize visual polish and responsive design.

phases.name: Advanced Integrations
phases.description: CRM integrations, social media, listings, and compliance

plugins.notes: Integration code must handle OAuth flows securely. Rate limiting essential for external APIs.

phases.name: AI Visibility & Analytics
phases.description: GEO platform, AI content agent, and advanced analytics

recommended_for.S043: feature-dev:code-architect (GEO platform is a major new capability)

plugins.notes: AI visibility is cutting-edge. Monitor industry developments. Start with basic scoring then iterate.

recommended_for.S050: feature-dev:code-architect (EX system can reuse CX survey patterns)

plugins.notes: EX features can leverage existing survey infrastructure. Focus on privacy and anonymity guarantees.

phases.name: Billing & Monetization
phases.description: Stripe payment integration, subscription management, and billing infrastructure

recommended_for.S056: stripe plugin (Create Stripe products/prices), feature-dev:code-architect (Payment architecture), /frontend-design (Pricing/billing UI)

plugins.notes: Critical revenue infrastructure. Test thoroughly in Stripe test mode. Security review mandatory for webhook handlers.

phases.name: Video Testimonials
phases.description: Video testimonial capture system with browser recording, file upload, AI transcription (OpenAI Whisper), AI text generation (Gemini), customer approval flow, and full dashboard integration

plugins.notes: Video feature is highly visible to customers. Prioritize mobile UX, fast AI processing, and intuitive approval flow. Security review required for public portal and AI integrations.

phases.name: Product Email Sequencing
phases.description: Comprehensive email lifecycle system: onboarding sequences, engagement triggers, retention emails, billing communications, milestone celebrations, re-engagement campaigns, and win-back flows. All product-triggered (not CRM).

recommended_for.S073: /frontend-design (Email design system must match Repwell brand)
recommended_for.S092: feature-dev:code-architect (A/B testing engine requires careful architecture)

plugins.notes: Email sequences directly impact revenue (onboarding→activation, dunning→recovery, win-back→reactivation). Prioritize mobile-friendly responsive emails. All copy must follow Repwell brand voice. A/B test aggressively. Track opens, clicks, conversions. Respect unsubscribe preferences. Build orchestration engine (S095) early as foundation for all sequences.
